guestPolicyApprovalHint: Guests are declared in the application and approved together with the participant. Adding or replacing guests after approval is not allowed; removal is possible before the event starts.
guestPolicyLocked: The guest policy cannot change after the first application, including withdrawn applications.
guestPolicyFieldsExist: Remove all guest questions before switching to Flexible Guests.
